# Higher-order proof core: constructor and native entry correspondence

Date: 2026-10-25
Scope: research representation and structural typing embedding only.
Baseline: `77df594169ad07ff9cb523699485cd0e7146e86f`.
Authority and exact dependencies: `tasks/agent-loop/sprints/higher-order-proof-core-20261025-r1.md`.
Verification and independent-review results belong to that sprint's immutable outcome.
No compiler, runtime, diagnostics, expectations or production architecture changes.

## 1. What the construction supplies

`CallEnvironmentRealization.close_body` consumes actual successful reads plus
`CellsTyped`; its values are `TypedCall.Value`. That grammar cannot contain a
`TypedCall.Function`, and `Original.Ty` cannot express a callable type. Even a
perfect free-variable layout cannot express a closure-valued cell in that model.
The new research core supplies a recursive callable type and ordinary lambda/
wrap values, with extrinsic typing after the mutually defined finite syntax.
The old Function body and adapters are translated structurally. Their existing
typing derivations construct the new value typing derivation.

This is a one-way, all-constructor typing-preserving embedding of the accepted
finite fragments. It is not typing reflection, injectivity of all evidence,
operational equivalence, source elaboration, or a full conservative-extension
proof. In particular, the old `original` wrappers disappear by structural
expansion; an Original literal and its TypedCall wrapper have the same target.

The operational paper `docs/yulang-operational-type-safety-ja.tex:85–98` declares
itself a paper construction/self-check and proposal. Its lambda/wrap/Call rules
at 220–224 and graph discussion at 258–267 are research targets, not independently
approved compiler architecture. The existing complete-Call authority's section1
records the user's authorization to supply legitimate definitions during proof
work. This packet changes no approved source behavior or original A/B claims.

## 2. Complete finite-fragment constructor map

| Existing input | Structural destination and preserved data |
| --- | --- |
| Original types: base, thunk, union, intersection, top, bottom | Same constructor recursively; same Base identity. Callable adds a new research type constructor. |
| Original values: var, unit, bool, int, floatBits, string, bytes, path, char | Same index or full literal payload; no conversion to a common string/number surrogate. |
| Original values: delay, inLeft, inRight, both, top | Same constructor and recursively translated code/value. Both retains the single underlying value and two extrinsic typing derivations. |
| Original computations: ret, force, bind, unionCase, chooseLeft, chooseRight, absurd | Same constructor and ordered children; bind/each union branch extends its own context at de Bruijn index zero. |
| TypedCall values: var, original, delay, view | Same var/delay/view; original expands the entire Original value. View occurrence identity and path are retained. |
| TypedCall computations: original, ret, bind, force, scope, expose, request, fail | Original expands structurally. Scope owner, both expose views, operation instance, saved continuation and failure reason retained. Request's continuation binds the response type at zero. |
| Adapter | Input/output types, entire body, ordered path correspondences and captured views retained. The old `typed` field supplies a new extrinsic proof; no recursive syntax depends on a typing judgment. |
| Function lambda | Mode, receipt, argument/body-result/result types, body and designated result consumer retained. Typed body parameter is A for Value and Thunk A for Computation. |
| Function wrap | Inner callable and ordered argument/result adapters retained. A function a→b becomes c→d using c→a and b→d adapters. |
| PortPath/ViewOccurrence | Structural components, port kind, recursively translated type and occurrence identity retained. |
| PathCorrespondence | Source and target paths retained with translated Prop-valued PathRule evidence. Existing proof fields are not reified into computational data. |
| OperationInstance | Operation identity, complete ordered type-argument list, payload and response types retained. |
| ReceiptTemplate/ReceiptSlot | Ordered profile, designated slot identities and paths retained. |

Context transport is pointwise: each successful old index lookup yields the
translated type at the same new index. This includes the empty-context transport
needed by old `original` terms and closed adapters under a surrounding target
context. It does not shift a free variable silently. Existing old Functions are
closed except for their explicit parameter; embedding them alone does not supply
an encoding of arbitrary native captured environments.

`PathRule` already lives in Prop. A proof of `adapterMap` cannot in general be
eliminated to recover its mappingIdentity as runtime data in Lean. The target
retains corresponding Prop evidence and explicit endpoint data; the claim is
**typing-derivation-free syntax**, not absence of every Prop field or recovery of
erased proof provenance. No new runtime evidence-erasure permission follows.

## 3. Actual source producers and consumers

Paths below are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/` and pinned by the
contract. These are inspected equations, not a Lean model of the whole Rust VM.

### Lambda formation and saved environment

`program.rs:819–850` translates LocalSource Lambda with full parameter identity,
unit/record-pattern data, optional field-default labels, role, root schema,
callback schema and body label. The role is Computation exactly when the
parameter annotation has an effect component, otherwise Value. Generated member
receiver lambdas at 1042–1064 use the same role rule and retain receiver identity,
unit flag, root/callback schema and body; their record pattern is None.

`machine.rs:181–205` stores these fields in `ExecutableValue::Closure` with a
saved environment index. `Instruction::Lambda` at 864–887 creates that closure
with the current environment. `data` at 2690 creates a Value-interface
ReceivedValue with an opaque receiving view. A closure is therefore already a
native value, and introducing a formal callable-as-value representation changes
no native representation.

The formal lambda carries code and typed binders; it does not yet carry a native
label/environment index or all unit/record/root/callback fields. The accepted
native arena/capture supplier explains address lookup and current-cell reads;
source body elaboration, layout coverage and metadata realization must connect
the fields before a native closure typing theorem can be claimed.

### Callee evaluation, whole argument carrier and receiver role

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument labels in Apply.
`machine.rs:888–900` pushes a Callee frame holding the argument label and caller
environment, then evaluates the callee. When that returns, `Frame::Callee` at
1181–1201 allocates an inert Delay of the entire argument code in the caller
environment, retains its receiving view, then dispatches on the actual returned
executable. Argument execution has not started at this point.

The closure branch at 1224–1329 uses the closure's saved environment; the local
pattern binding shadows the caller-environment variable. It applies the received
dispatch substitution to that environment, establishes an invocation owner and
ReceiverReturn frame, then selects the closure's actual role. ReceiverReturn
contains activation/previous owner fields, not an environment field.

Value role pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument. Computation role
creates any declared root/receipt view, binds the Delay itself as a Computation
parameter in the saved environment, and evaluates the body without forcing the
argument. This supports the formal A versus Thunk A distinction. It does not
prove that root/callback receipts or dispatch metadata realize formal paths.

A new `dynamicCall` has a value callee and a thunk-valued argument. Source Apply
also evaluates a callee computation; its eventual translation needs a preceding
bind and capture-avoiding shifts of the argument code. No all-source Apply
elaboration theorem is claimed by the Function embedding.

Native call dispatch also accepts Primitive, Continuation and operation
providers, with their own entry behavior and suffix ownership. Finite lambda/
wrap syntax is not universal coverage of these providers. Full Call adequacy
still needs those branches and its original independent quantifiers.

### Actual Value entry and patterns

`Frame::ValueEntry` at 1438–1488 first validates and introduces any callback
schema. The schema check can fail on pattern form, owner, parameter identity,
source root or received interface. It then handles record fields, unit validation
or an ordinary full parameter bind. A unit pattern validates Unit and does not
introduce an ordinary parameter cell. Record patterns bind actual fields/default
results one by one; `RecordDefault` at 1489–1498 and `bind_record_parameter` at
2655–2689 preserve the environment extended by earlier fields. Defaults evaluate
in that environment and can suspend/fail/diverge. Computation entry does not
branch on these pattern flags before binding its Delay.

The one-binder formal lambda rule covers its existing abstract body contract.
Source pattern elaboration must separately construct that body and prove the
field/default staging laws; simply ignoring pattern flags is not correspondence.

### Names and current cells

`program.rs:780–805` resolves imported names using retained imported bindings and
supplies parameter NameConsumption from the role table; other names Observe.
Inconsistent supplied consumption evidence is rejected. `machine.rs:781–862`
resolves the full parameter/local/catch identity (or global definition index),
reads the current cell, performs dispatch-name transport, then consumes it.
Uninitialized globals trigger initialization; uninitialized lexical cells fail.
`consume` at 2469–2501 validates receiving metadata, records a receipt, and either
returns the value or executes a Computation-interface value with substitution.
`execute_with_substitution` at 2551–2583 accepts Delay/Request executables and can
fail with ExpectedComputation for other representations.

Therefore a formal variable lookup alone does not prove source Name execution:
layout/address/current-value typing, observation versus execution, dispatch,
receipts and initialization remain separate source obligations. Old represented
capture typing can be transported to the new core because its actual successful
reads are already available; it cannot magically encode native closure graphs.

## 4. Parent consumption and exact remaining inputs

The selected formal endpoint turns each existing `FunctionTyped f a b` into a
value typing derivation of callable(embed a,embed b). Such a value can inhabit a
response binder, serve as a higher-order argument and be stored in the generic
native Store. The old successful capture supplier's per-index typing derivations
can be embedded without replacing its read-success premises by an opaque claim.
This removes the *missing callable value syntax* part of ENV-CALLABLE-1 only.

| Remaining gate | Exact evidence still needed / source owner |
| --- | --- |
| HO-SUBSTITUTION-1 | Capture-avoiding substitution/weakening for the new full syntax, including lambda/adapter binders and callable-valued request continuations. Owner: higher-order proof lane. |
| ENV-LAYOUT-1 | Construct finite free-variable layouts from real body labels/resolved identities, including nested source binders and pattern/default scopes. Owner: program construction plus body elaboration. |
| ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 | Encode actual current ReceivedValue/executable cells at all needed higher-order types, preserving views/interface/dispatch. Owner: machine cell producers and receiving/dispatch representation. |
| ENV-GRAPH-1 | Finite shared and recursive closure/delay graph readback and typing, including preallocated uninitialized cells. Owner: machine local/global initialization and graph proof. |
| ENV-CALLABLE-1 | Close source body using the actual layout/current cells; connect native role, patterns, result consumer and metadata to the new lambda/wrap value. Owner: program Lambda/Apply and machine Callee/ValueEntry. |
| ENV-DISPATCH-1 / RESPONSE-TEMPLATE-1 | Typed metadata/frame interpretation and error exclusion; previously proved address/replay structure is insufficient. Owner: dispatch/receiving/template constructors and consumers. |
| Whole source/Call/Force/inference A/B | All constructors, substitutions, traces, constraints, propagation, levels/generalization and original premises remain at their original owners. |

No runtime defect was demonstrated at Lambda/Callee or Value/Computation entry:
NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE. No change to source restrictions, runtime behavior, expected
outputs, or compiler acceptance is inferred from the new research typing rules.

# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain

producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

## Intake and checks

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`
invocation failed because the executable was absent; the generation was then
performed with python3. This was a file-writing failure before any write, not a

inspection, distinguishing examples, repairs after author STOP and fresh

import YulangClosure.HigherOrderSyntax
import YulangClosure.CallEnvironmentRealization

namespace YulangClosure.HigherOrder

def embedTy : Original.Ty → Ty
  | .base b => .base b
  | .thunk a => .thunk (embedTy a)
  | .union a b => .union (embedTy a) (embedTy b)
  | .intersection a b => .intersection (embedTy a) (embedTy b)
  | .top => .top
  | .bottom => .bottom

def embedPort : TypedCall.PortKind → PortKind
  | .carrier => .carrier
  | .callEffect => .callEffect
  | .result => .result

def embedPath (p : TypedCall.PortPath) : PortPath :=
  ⟨p.components, embedPort p.port, embedTy p.type⟩

def embedOccurrence (v : TypedCall.ViewOccurrence) : ViewOccurrence :=
  ⟨v.identity, embedPath v.path⟩

/-- Prop-to-Prop translation: no erased mapping identity is reified as data. -/
theorem embedPathRule {p q : TypedCall.PortPath} (h : TypedCall.PathRule p q) :
    PathRule (embedPath p) (embedPath q) := by
  induction h with
  | identity p => exact .identity _
  | «prefix» label p q h ih => exact .prefix label _ _ ih
  | adapterMap identity p q => exact .adapterMap identity _ _

def embedCorrespondence (p : TypedCall.PathCorrespondence) : PathCorrespondence :=
  ⟨embedPath p.source, embedPath p.target, embedPathRule p.rule⟩

def embedOperation (op : TypedCall.OperationInstance) : OperationInstance :=
  ⟨op.operation, op.typeArguments.map embedTy, embedTy op.payloadType, embedTy op.responseType⟩

def embedSlot (s : TypedCall.ReceiptSlot) : ReceiptSlot := ⟨s.slot, embedPath s.path⟩
def embedReceipt (r : TypedCall.ReceiptTemplate) : ReceiptTemplate :=
  ⟨r.profile.map embedPath, r.designatedSlots.map embedSlot⟩

def embedPorts (p : TypedCall.InterfacePorts) : InterfacePorts :=
  ⟨p.interface, embedPath p.callEffect, embedPath p.result,
    embedOccurrence p.callEffectView, embedOccurrence p.resultView⟩

mutual
  def embedOriginalValue : Original.Val → Value
    | .var i => .var i
    | .unit => .unit
    | .bool v => .bool v
    | .int v => .int v
    | .floatBits v => .floatBits v
    | .string v => .string v
    | .bytes v => .bytes v
    | .path v => .path v
    | .char v => .char v
    | .delay c => .delay (embedOriginalComp c)
    | .inLeft v => .inLeft (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .inRight v => .inRight (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .both v => .both (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .top v => .top (embedOriginalValue v)
  def embedOriginalComp : Original.Comp → Comp
    | .ret v => .ret (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .force v => .force (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (embedOriginalComp m) (embedOriginalComp n)
    | .unionCase v l r => .unionCase (embedOriginalValue v)
        (embedOriginalComp l) (embedOriginalComp r)
    | .chooseLeft v => .chooseLeft (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .chooseRight v => .chooseRight (embedOriginalValue v)
    | .absurd v => .absurd (embedOriginalValue v)
end

mutual
  def embedValue : TypedCall.Value → Value
    | .var i => .var i
    | .original v => embedOriginalValue v
    | .delay c => .delay (embedComp c)
    | .view v o => .view (embedValue v) (embedOccurrence o)
  def embedComp : TypedCall.Comp → Comp
    | .original c => embedOriginalComp c
    | .ret v => .ret (embedValue v)
    | .bind m n => .bind (embedComp m) (embedComp n)
    | .force v => .force (embedValue v)
    | .scope owner c => .scope owner (embedComp c)
    | .expose e r c => .expose (embedOccurrence e) (embedOccurrence r) (embedComp c)
    | .request op v k => .request (embedOperation op) (embedValue v) (embedComp k)
    | .fail reason => .fail reason
end

def embedAdapter (a : TypedCall.Adapter) : Adapter :=
  .mk (embedTy a.input) (embedTy a.output) (embedComp a.body)
    (a.pathCorrespondences.map embedCorrespondence) (a.capturedViews.map embedOccurrence)

def embedFunction : TypedCall.Function → Value
  | .lambda mode receipt a b r body consumer =>
      .lambda mode (embedReceipt receipt) (embedTy a) (embedTy b) (embedTy r)
        (embedComp body) (embedAdapter consumer)
  | .wrap f a r => .wrap (embedFunction f) (embedAdapter a) (embedAdapter r)

/-- Universal in the target context; closed old syntax needs no weakening axiom. -/
def ContextEmbedding (old : Original.Context) (new : Context) : Prop :=
  ∀ i a, old i = some a → new i = some (embedTy a)

theorem empty_embedding (env : Context) : ContextEmbedding Original.emptyContext env := by
  intro i a h
  cases h

theorem extend_embedding {old : Original.Context} {new : Context}
    (h : ContextEmbedding old new) (a : Original.Ty) :
    ContextEmbedding (Original.extend old a) (extend new (embedTy a)) := by
  intro i b hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Original.extend, Option.some.injEq] at hi
      subst b
      rfl
  | succ i => exact h i b hi

mutual
  theorem embedOriginalValue_typed {old : Original.Context} {v : Original.Val} {a : Original.Ty}
      (h : Original.ValTyped old v a) {new : Context} (he : ContextEmbedding old new) :
      ValueTyped new (embedOriginalValue v) (embedTy a) := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact .var (he _ _ h)
    | unit => exact .unit
    | bool => exact .bool
    | int => exact .int
    | floatBits => exact .floatBits
    | string => exact .string
    | bytes => exact .bytes
    | path => exact .path
    | char => exact .char
    | delay h => exact .delay (embedOriginalComp_typed h he)
    | inLeft h => exact .inLeft (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | inRight h => exact .inRight (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | both h k => exact .both (embedOriginalValue_typed h he) (embedOriginalValue_typed k he)
    | top h => exact .top (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
  theorem embedOriginalComp_typed {old : Original.Context} {c : Original.Comp} {a : Original.Ty}
      (h : Original.CompTyped old c a) {new : Context} (he : ContextEmbedding old new) :
      CompTyped new (embedOriginalComp c) (embedTy a) := by
    cases h with
    | ret h => exact .ret (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | force h => exact .force (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | bind h k =>
        exact .bind (embedOriginalComp_typed h he)
          (embedOriginalComp_typed k (extend_embedding he _))
    | unionCase h l r =>
        exact .unionCase (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
          (embedOriginalComp_typed l (extend_embedding he _))
          (embedOriginalComp_typed r (extend_embedding he _))
    | chooseLeft h => exact .chooseLeft (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | chooseRight h => exact .chooseRight (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
    | absurd h => exact .absurd (embedOriginalValue_typed h he)
end

mutual
  theorem embedValue_typed {old : Original.Context} {v : TypedCall.Value} {a : Original.Ty}
      (h : TypedCall.ValueTyped old v a) {new : Context} (he : ContextEmbedding old new) :
      ValueTyped new (embedValue v) (embedTy a) := by
    cases h with
    | var h => exact .var (he _ _ h)
    | original h => exact embedOriginalValue_typed h (empty_embedding _)
    | delay h => exact .delay (embedComp_typed h he)
    | view h => exact .view (embedValue_typed h he)
  theorem embedComp_typed {old : Original.Context} {c : TypedCall.Comp} {a : Original.Ty}
      (h : TypedCall.CompTyped old c a) {new : Context} (he : ContextEmbedding old new) :
      CompTyped new (embedComp c) (embedTy a) := by
    cases h with
    | original h => exact embedOriginalComp_typed h (empty_embedding _)
    | ret h => exact .ret (embedValue_typed h he)
    | bind h k => exact .bind (embedComp_typed h he) (embedComp_typed k (extend_embedding he _))
    | force h => exact .force (embedValue_typed h he)
    | scope h => exact .scope (embedComp_typed h he)
    | expose e r h => exact .expose (embedComp_typed h he)
    | request h k =>
        exact .request (embedValue_typed h he)
          (embedComp_typed k (extend_embedding he _))
    | fail => exact .fail
end

theorem embedAdapter_typed (a : TypedCall.Adapter) (env : Context) :
    AdapterTyped env (embedAdapter a) (embedTy a.input) (embedTy a.output) :=
  .mk (embedComp_typed a.typed (extend_embedding (empty_embedding env) a.input))

theorem embedFunction_typed {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (h : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (env : Context) :
    ValueTyped env (embedFunction f) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) := by
  induction h with
  | lambdaValue receipt a bodyResult result body consumer hb hc hr =>
      exact .lambdaValue (embedComp_typed hb (extend_embedding (empty_embedding env) a))
        (by simpa only [hc, hr] using embedAdapter_typed consumer env)
  | lambdaComputation receipt a bodyResult result body consumer hb hc hr =>
      exact .lambdaComputation
        (embedComp_typed hb (extend_embedding (empty_embedding env) (.thunk a)))
        (by simpa only [hc, hr] using embedAdapter_typed consumer env)
  | @wrap f argumentAdapter resultAdapter a b c d hf ha hao hr hro ih =>
      exact .wrap ih
        (by simpa only [ha, hao] using embedAdapter_typed argumentAdapter env)
        (by simpa only [hr, hro] using embedAdapter_typed resultAdapter env)

/-- Callable values inhabit response binders; no Function-only response sort. -/
theorem callable_response (env : Context) (a b : Ty) :
    CompTyped (extend env (.callable a b)) (.ret (.var 0)) (.callable a b) :=
  .ret (.var rfl)

/-- A request can bind and return an actual callable-typed response. -/
theorem request_callable_response (env : Context) (operation : Nat)
    (typeArguments : List Ty) (payloadType a b : Ty) (payload : Value)
    (hp : ValueTyped env payload payloadType) :
    CompTyped env
      (.request ⟨operation, typeArguments, payloadType, .callable a b⟩ payload (.ret (.var 0)))
      (.callable a b) :=
  .request hp (callable_response env a b)

/-- Old functions are now usable as higher-order arguments (delayed carrier). -/
theorem function_as_argument {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (h : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (env : Context) :
    ValueTyped env (.delay (.ret (embedFunction f))) (.thunk (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b))) :=
  .delay (.ret (embedFunction_typed h env))

theorem call_with_function_argument {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (h : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) {env : Context} {g : Value} {result : Ty}
    (hg : ValueTyped env g (.callable (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) result)) :
    CompTyped env (.dynamicCall g (.delay (.ret (embedFunction f)))) result :=
  .dynamicCall hg (function_as_argument h env)

/-- Generic native cells can hold the new typed callable value. This is a formal
store construction, not readback of a Rust Closure or a source layout theorem. -/
theorem function_cell {f : TypedCall.Function} {a b : Original.Ty}
    (h : TypedCall.FunctionTyped f a b) (store : NativeClosureEnvironment.Store Value) :
    (store.push (embedFunction f)).cell store.size = some (embedFunction f) ∧
      ValueTyped emptyContext (embedFunction f) (.callable (embedTy a) (embedTy b)) :=
  ⟨NativeClosureEnvironment.push_current _ _, embedFunction_typed h _⟩

def embedStore (store : Nat → Option TypedCall.Value) : Nat → Option Value :=
  fun cell => (store cell).map embedValue

/-- Read the same address in the pointwise-translated current store. -/
def readEmbedded [DecidableEq K] (arena : NativeClosureEnvironment.Arena K D)
    (env : Nat) (store : Nat → Option Value) (ref : CallEnvironmentRealization.Reference K) :
    Option Value := (CallEnvironmentRealization.address arena env ref).bind store

theorem read_embedding [DecidableEq K] (arena : NativeClosureEnvironment.Arena K D)
    (env : Nat) (store : Nat → Option TypedCall.Value)
    (ref : CallEnvironmentRealization.Reference K) :
    readEmbedded arena env (embedStore store) ref =
      (CallEnvironmentRealization.read arena env store ref).map embedValue := by
  cases h : CallEnvironmentRealization.address arena env ref <;>
    simp [readEmbedded, CallEnvironmentRealization.read, embedStore, h]

theorem read_embedding_typed [DecidableEq K]
    {arena : NativeClosureEnvironment.Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option TypedCall.Value} {layout : CallEnvironmentRealization.Layout K}
    (cells : CallEnvironmentRealization.CellsTyped arena env store layout)
    {ref : CallEnvironmentRealization.Reference K} {a : Original.Ty}
    (hm : (ref, a) ∈ layout) {v : TypedCall.Value}
    (hr : CallEnvironmentRealization.read arena env store ref = some v) :
    readEmbedded arena env (embedStore store) ref = some (embedValue v) ∧
      ValueTyped emptyContext (embedValue v) (embedTy a) := by
  constructor
  · rw [read_embedding, hr]
    rfl
  · exact embedValue_typed (CallEnvironmentRealization.successful_read_typed cells hm hr)
      (empty_embedding _)

/-- Successful represented CURRENT reads supply actual embedded cell values. -/
theorem captured_value_typed [DecidableEq K]
    {arena : NativeClosureEnvironment.Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option TypedCall.Value} {layout : CallEnvironmentRealization.Layout K}
    {values : List TypedCall.Value}
    (success : CallEnvironmentRealization.realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CallEnvironmentRealization.CellsTyped arena env store layout)
    (filler : TypedCall.Value) (i : Nat) (a : Original.Ty)
    (hi : CallEnvironmentRealization.context layout i = some a) :
    ValueTyped emptyContext
      (embedValue (CallEnvironmentRealization.substitution filler values i)) (embedTy a) :=
  embedValue_typed (CallEnvironmentRealization.realized_substitution_typed
    success cells filler i a hi) (empty_embedding _)

/-- Apply the actual capture supplier to the parent body before embedding. -/
theorem captured_body_typed [DecidableEq K]
    {arena : NativeClosureEnvironment.Arena K D} {env : Nat}
    {store : Nat → Option TypedCall.Value} {layout : CallEnvironmentRealization.Layout K}
    {values : List TypedCall.Value}
    (success : CallEnvironmentRealization.realize arena env store layout = some values)
    (cells : CallEnvironmentRealization.CellsTyped arena env store layout)
    (filler : TypedCall.Value) {body : TypedCall.Comp} {a : Original.Ty}
    (hb : TypedCall.CompTyped (CallEnvironmentRealization.context layout) body a) :
    CompTyped emptyContext (embedComp (TypedCall.substituteCallComp
      (CallEnvironmentRealization.substitution filler values) body)) (embedTy a) :=
  embedComp_typed (CallEnvironmentRealization.close_body success cells filler hb) (empty_embedding _)

end YulangClosure.HigherOrder

# Higher-order proof core: constructor and native entry correspondence

Date: 2026-10-25
Scope: research representation and structural typing embedding only.
Baseline: `77df594169ad07ff9cb523699485cd0e7146e86f`.
Authority and exact dependencies: `tasks/agent-loop/sprints/higher-order-proof-core-20261025-r1.md`.
Verification and independent-review results belong to that sprint's immutable outcome.
No compiler, runtime, diagnostics, expectations or production architecture changes.

## 1. What the construction supplies

`CallEnvironmentRealization.close_body` consumes actual successful reads plus
`CellsTyped`; its values are `TypedCall.Value`. That grammar cannot contain a
`TypedCall.Function`, and `Original.Ty` cannot express a callable type. Even a
perfect free-variable layout cannot express a closure-valued cell in that model.
The new research core supplies a recursive callable type and ordinary lambda/
wrap values, with extrinsic typing after the mutually defined finite syntax.
The old Function body and adapters are translated structurally. Their existing
typing derivations construct the new value typing derivation.

This is a one-way, all-constructor typing-preserving embedding of the accepted
finite fragments. It is not typing reflection, injectivity of all evidence,
operational equivalence, source elaboration, or a full conservative-extension
proof. In particular, the old `original` wrappers disappear by structural
expansion; an Original literal and its TypedCall wrapper have the same target.

The operational paper `docs/yulang-operational-type-safety-ja.tex:85–98` declares
itself a paper construction/self-check and proposal. Its lambda/wrap/Call rules
at 220–224 and graph discussion at 258–267 are research targets, not independently
approved compiler architecture. The existing complete-Call authority's section1
records the user's authorization to supply legitimate definitions during proof
work. This packet changes no approved source behavior or original A/B claims.

## 2. Complete finite-fragment constructor map

| Existing input | Structural destination and preserved data |
| --- | --- |
| Original types: base, thunk, union, intersection, top, bottom | Same constructor recursively; same Base identity. Callable adds a new research type constructor. |
| Original values: var, unit, bool, int, floatBits, string, bytes, path, char | Same index or full literal payload; no conversion to a common string/number surrogate. |
| Original values: delay, inLeft, inRight, both, top | Same constructor and recursively translated code/value. Both retains the single underlying value and two extrinsic typing derivations. |
| Original computations: ret, force, bind, unionCase, chooseLeft, chooseRight, absurd | Same constructor and ordered children; bind/each union branch extends its own context at de Bruijn index zero. |
| TypedCall values: var, original, delay, view | Same var/delay/view; original expands the entire Original value. View occurrence identity and path are retained. |
| TypedCall computations: original, ret, bind, force, scope, expose, request, fail | Original expands structurally. Scope owner, both expose views, operation instance, saved continuation and failure reason retained. Request's continuation binds the response type at zero. |
| Adapter | Input/output types, entire body, ordered path correspondences and captured views retained. The old `typed` field supplies a new extrinsic proof; no recursive syntax depends on a typing judgment. |
| Function lambda | Mode, receipt, argument/body-result/result types, body and designated result consumer retained. Typed body parameter is A for Value and Thunk A for Computation. |
| Function wrap | Inner callable and ordered argument/result adapters retained. A function a→b becomes c→d using c→a and b→d adapters. |
| PortPath/ViewOccurrence | Structural components, port kind, recursively translated type and occurrence identity retained. |
| PathCorrespondence | Source and target paths retained with translated Prop-valued PathRule evidence. Existing proof fields are not reified into computational data. |
| OperationInstance | Operation identity, complete ordered type-argument list, payload and response types retained. |
| ReceiptTemplate/ReceiptSlot | Ordered profile, designated slot identities and paths retained. |

Context transport is pointwise: each successful old index lookup yields the
translated type at the same new index. This includes the empty-context transport
needed by old `original` terms and closed adapters under a surrounding target
context. It does not shift a free variable silently. Existing old Functions are
closed except for their explicit parameter; embedding them alone does not supply
an encoding of arbitrary native captured environments.

`PathRule` already lives in Prop. A proof of `adapterMap` cannot in general be
eliminated to recover its mappingIdentity as runtime data in Lean. The target
retains corresponding Prop evidence and explicit endpoint data; the claim is
**typing-derivation-free syntax**, not absence of every Prop field or recovery of
erased proof provenance. No new runtime evidence-erasure permission follows.

## 3. Actual source producers and consumers

Paths below are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/` and pinned by the
contract. These are inspected equations, not a Lean model of the whole Rust VM.

### Lambda formation and saved environment

`program.rs:819–850` translates LocalSource Lambda with full parameter identity,
unit/record-pattern data, optional field-default labels, role, root schema,
callback schema and body label. The role is Computation exactly when the
parameter annotation has an effect component, otherwise Value. Generated member
receiver lambdas at 1042–1064 use the same role rule and retain receiver identity,
unit flag, root/callback schema and body; their record pattern is None.

`machine.rs:181–205` stores these fields in `ExecutableValue::Closure` with a
saved environment index. `Instruction::Lambda` at 864–887 creates that closure
with the current environment. `data` at 2690 creates a Value-interface
ReceivedValue with an opaque receiving view. A closure is therefore already a
native value, and introducing a formal callable-as-value representation changes
no native representation.

The formal lambda carries code and typed binders; it does not yet carry a native
label/environment index or all unit/record/root/callback fields. The accepted
native arena/capture supplier explains address lookup and current-cell reads;
source body elaboration, layout coverage and metadata realization must connect
the fields before a native closure typing theorem can be claimed.

### Callee evaluation, whole argument carrier and receiver role

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument labels in Apply.
`machine.rs:888–900` pushes a Callee frame holding the argument label and caller
environment, then evaluates the callee. When that returns, `Frame::Callee` at
1181–1201 allocates an inert Delay of the entire argument code in the caller
environment, retains its receiving view, then dispatches on the actual returned
executable. Argument execution has not started at this point.

The closure branch at 1224–1329 uses the closure's saved environment; the local
pattern binding shadows the caller-environment variable. It applies the received
dispatch substitution to that environment, establishes an invocation owner and
ReceiverReturn frame, then selects the closure's actual role. ReceiverReturn
contains activation/previous owner fields, not an environment field.

Value role pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument. Computation role
creates any declared root/receipt view, binds the Delay itself as a Computation
parameter in the saved environment, and evaluates the body without forcing the
argument. This supports the formal A versus Thunk A distinction. It does not
prove that root/callback receipts or dispatch metadata realize formal paths.

A new `dynamicCall` has a value callee and a thunk-valued argument. Source Apply
also evaluates a callee computation; its eventual translation needs a preceding
bind and capture-avoiding shifts of the argument code. No all-source Apply
elaboration theorem is claimed by the Function embedding.

Native call dispatch also accepts Primitive, Continuation and operation
providers, with their own entry behavior and suffix ownership. Finite lambda/
wrap syntax is not universal coverage of these providers. Full Call adequacy
still needs those branches and its original independent quantifiers.

### Actual Value entry and patterns

`Frame::ValueEntry` at 1438–1488 first validates and introduces any callback
schema. The schema check can fail on pattern form, owner, parameter identity,
source root or received interface. It then handles record fields, unit validation
or an ordinary full parameter bind. A unit pattern validates Unit and does not
introduce an ordinary parameter cell. Record patterns bind actual fields/default
results one by one; `RecordDefault` at 1489–1498 and `bind_record_parameter` at
2655–2689 preserve the environment extended by earlier fields. Defaults evaluate
in that environment and can suspend/fail/diverge. Computation entry does not
branch on these pattern flags before binding its Delay.

The one-binder formal lambda rule covers its existing abstract body contract.
Source pattern elaboration must separately construct that body and prove the
field/default staging laws; simply ignoring pattern flags is not correspondence.

### Names and current cells

`program.rs:780–805` resolves imported names using retained imported bindings and
supplies parameter NameConsumption from the role table; other names Observe.
Inconsistent supplied consumption evidence is rejected. `machine.rs:781–862`
resolves the full parameter/local/catch identity (or global definition index),
reads the current cell, performs dispatch-name transport, then consumes it.
Uninitialized globals trigger initialization; uninitialized lexical cells fail.
`consume` at 2469–2501 validates receiving metadata, records a receipt, and either
returns the value or executes a Computation-interface value with substitution.
`execute_with_substitution` at 2551–2583 accepts Delay/Request executables and can
fail with ExpectedComputation for other representations.

Therefore a formal variable lookup alone does not prove source Name execution:
layout/address/current-value typing, observation versus execution, dispatch,
receipts and initialization remain separate source obligations. Old represented
capture typing can be transported to the new core because its actual successful
reads are already available; it cannot magically encode native closure graphs.

## 4. Parent consumption and exact remaining inputs

The selected formal endpoint turns each existing `FunctionTyped f a b` into a
value typing derivation of callable(embed a,embed b). Such a value can inhabit a
response binder, serve as a higher-order argument and be stored in the generic
native Store. The old successful capture supplier's per-index typing derivations
can be embedded without replacing its read-success premises by an opaque claim.
This removes the *missing callable value syntax* part of ENV-CALLABLE-1 only.

| Remaining gate | Exact evidence still needed / source owner |
| --- | --- |
| HO-SUBSTITUTION-1 | Capture-avoiding substitution/weakening for the new full syntax, including lambda/adapter binders and callable-valued request continuations. Owner: higher-order proof lane. |
| ENV-LAYOUT-1 | Construct finite free-variable layouts from real body labels/resolved identities, including nested source binders and pattern/default scopes. Owner: program construction plus body elaboration. |
| ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 | Encode actual current ReceivedValue/executable cells at all needed higher-order types, preserving views/interface/dispatch. Owner: machine cell producers and receiving/dispatch representation. |
| ENV-GRAPH-1 | Finite shared and recursive closure/delay graph readback and typing, including preallocated uninitialized cells. Owner: machine local/global initialization and graph proof. |
| ENV-CALLABLE-1 | Close source body using the actual layout/current cells; connect native role, patterns, result consumer and metadata to the new lambda/wrap value. Owner: program Lambda/Apply and machine Callee/ValueEntry. |
| ENV-DISPATCH-1 / RESPONSE-TEMPLATE-1 | Typed metadata/frame interpretation and error exclusion; previously proved address/replay structure is insufficient. Owner: dispatch/receiving/template constructors and consumers. |
| Whole source/Call/Force/inference A/B | All constructors, substitutions, traces, constraints, propagation, levels/generalization and original premises remain at their original owners. |

No runtime defect was demonstrated at Lambda/Callee or Value/Computation entry:
NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE. No change to source restrictions, runtime behavior, expected
outputs, or compiler acceptance is inferred from the new research typing rules.
design_note_text:
# Higher-order research core and structural embedding

Status: Draft research construction; checking and review evidence is recorded in
the sprint outcome and its frozen receipts. This is not production authority.
Scope: frozen LEAN-HIGHER-ORDER-PROOF-CORE-20261025/r1 research representation.
Initial author: /root/higher_order_proof_core_astra_r1; requested gpt-6-astra/medium,
observed model/effort UNKNOWN. Primary /root repairs and integrates after author
STOP; the outcome records final authorship and independent review. No descendants.
Production authority: none. The operational paper is a proposal/target; the
2026-10-07 complete-Call definition §1 records permission for legitimate research
definitions, not adoption of this representation as compiler architecture.

The parent RESPONSE-ENCODING-1 / ENV-CALLABLE-1 lacked a callable constructor in
its formal Value sort. The candidate removes that specific representational
obstruction by constructing a new callable type and actual lambda/wrap values.
Every Original.Val/Comp and TypedCall.Value/Comp/Adapter/Function constructor is
mapped structurally. No old term is retained behind an opaque original opcode.
The full parent, native readback and operational safety remain OPEN.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

## Remaining source obligations and reuse

Accepted CoreSyntax typing and CallEnvironmentRealization supply precisely their
existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,
Simple-sub bypass or production implementation is introduced.

Luna/source intake owns ENV-LAYOUT-1 (resolved free-variable order and binder
indices from source Lambda/Name/Apply), ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 (current native Value
encoding), ENV-GRAPH-1 (recursive cell/closure graphs), ENV-CALLABLE-1's remaining
native body/consumer mapping, and ENV-DISPATCH-1. Relevant native owners remain
machine.rs `Instruction::Lambda`, `Frame::ValueEntry`, `Machine::lookup`,
`Machine::extend`, closure/Callee branches and receiving.rs lambda schema
construction. The primary's disjoint source map gives their complete exact
producer/consumer inventory, including unit/record/default entry cases.
Force, native transitions, new-core substitution/progress/preservation,
whole-trace safety, operation authenticity and original inference A/B remain
OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.

No Lean/build/tests/native checks were run by the author. A shell `python`

# Higher-order proof core: constructor and native entry correspondence

Date: 2026-10-25
Scope: research representation and structural typing embedding only.
Baseline: `77df594169ad07ff9cb523699485cd0e7146e86f`.
Authority and exact dependencies: `tasks/agent-loop/sprints/higher-order-proof-core-20261025-r1.md`.
Verification and independent-review results belong to that sprint's immutable outcome.
No compiler, runtime, diagnostics, expectations or production architecture changes.

## 1. What the construction supplies

`CallEnvironmentRealization.close_body` consumes actual successful reads plus
`CellsTyped`; its values are `TypedCall.Value`. That grammar cannot contain a
`TypedCall.Function`, and `Original.Ty` cannot express a callable type. Even a
perfect free-variable layout cannot express a closure-valued cell in that model.
The new research core supplies a recursive callable type and ordinary lambda/
wrap values, with extrinsic typing after the mutually defined finite syntax.
The old Function body and adapters are translated structurally. Their existing
typing derivations construct the new value typing derivation.

This is a one-way, all-constructor typing-preserving embedding of the accepted
finite fragments. It is not typing reflection, injectivity of all evidence,
operational equivalence, source elaboration, or a full conservative-extension
proof. In particular, the old `original` wrappers disappear by structural
expansion; an Original literal and its TypedCall wrapper have the same target.

The operational paper `docs/yulang-operational-type-safety-ja.tex:85–98` declares
itself a paper construction/self-check and proposal. Its lambda/wrap/Call rules
at 220–224 and graph discussion at 258–267 are research targets, not independently
approved compiler architecture. The existing complete-Call authority's section1
records the user's authorization to supply legitimate definitions during proof
work. This packet changes no approved source behavior or original A/B claims.

## 2. Complete finite-fragment constructor map

| Existing input | Structural destination and preserved data |
| --- | --- |
| Original types: base, thunk, union, intersection, top, bottom | Same constructor recursively; same Base identity. Callable adds a new research type constructor. |
| Original values: var, unit, bool, int, floatBits, string, bytes, path, char | Same index or full literal payload; no conversion to a common string/number surrogate. |
| Original values: delay, inLeft, inRight, both, top | Same constructor and recursively translated code/value. Both retains the single underlying value and two extrinsic typing derivations. |
| Original computations: ret, force, bind, unionCase, chooseLeft, chooseRight, absurd | Same constructor and ordered children; bind/each union branch extends its own context at de Bruijn index zero. |
| TypedCall values: var, original, delay, view | Same var/delay/view; original expands the entire Original value. View occurrence identity and path are retained. |
| TypedCall computations: original, ret, bind, force, scope, expose, request, fail | Original expands structurally. Scope owner, both expose views, operation instance, saved continuation and failure reason retained. Request's continuation binds the response type at zero. |
| Adapter | Input/output types, entire body, ordered path correspondences and captured views retained. The old `typed` field supplies a new extrinsic proof; no recursive syntax depends on a typing judgment. |
| Function lambda | Mode, receipt, argument/body-result/result types, body and designated result consumer retained. Typed body parameter is A for Value and Thunk A for Computation. |
| Function wrap | Inner callable and ordered argument/result adapters retained. A function a→b becomes c→d using c→a and b→d adapters. |
| PortPath/ViewOccurrence | Structural components, port kind, recursively translated type and occurrence identity retained. |
| PathCorrespondence | Source and target paths retained with translated Prop-valued PathRule evidence. Existing proof fields are not reified into computational data. |
| OperationInstance | Operation identity, complete ordered type-argument list, payload and response types retained. |
| ReceiptTemplate/ReceiptSlot | Ordered profile, designated slot identities and paths retained. |

Context transport is pointwise: each successful old index lookup yields the
translated type at the same new index. This includes the empty-context transport
needed by old `original` terms and closed adapters under a surrounding target
context. It does not shift a free variable silently. Existing old Functions are
closed except for their explicit parameter; embedding them alone does not supply
an encoding of arbitrary native captured environments.

`PathRule` already lives in Prop. A proof of `adapterMap` cannot in general be
eliminated to recover its mappingIdentity as runtime data in Lean. The target
retains corresponding Prop evidence and explicit endpoint data; the claim is
**typing-derivation-free syntax**, not absence of every Prop field or recovery of
erased proof provenance. No new runtime evidence-erasure permission follows.

## 3. Actual source producers and consumers

Paths below are under `tools/inference-playground/src/runtime/` and pinned by the
contract. These are inspected equations, not a Lean model of the whole Rust VM.

### Lambda formation and saved environment

`program.rs:819–850` translates LocalSource Lambda with full parameter identity,
unit/record-pattern data, optional field-default labels, role, root schema,
callback schema and body label. The role is Computation exactly when the
parameter annotation has an effect component, otherwise Value. Generated member
receiver lambdas at 1042–1064 use the same role rule and retain receiver identity,
unit flag, root/callback schema and body; their record pattern is None.

`machine.rs:181–205` stores these fields in `ExecutableValue::Closure` with a
saved environment index. `Instruction::Lambda` at 864–887 creates that closure
with the current environment. `data` at 2690 creates a Value-interface
ReceivedValue with an opaque receiving view. A closure is therefore already a
native value, and introducing a formal callable-as-value representation changes
no native representation.

The formal lambda carries code and typed binders; it does not yet carry a native
label/environment index or all unit/record/root/callback fields. The accepted
native arena/capture supplier explains address lookup and current-cell reads;
source body elaboration, layout coverage and metadata realization must connect
the fields before a native closure typing theorem can be claimed.

### Callee evaluation, whole argument carrier and receiver role

`program.rs:852–857` retains both callee and argument labels in Apply.
`machine.rs:888–900` pushes a Callee frame holding the argument label and caller
environment, then evaluates the callee. When that returns, `Frame::Callee` at
1181–1201 allocates an inert Delay of the entire argument code in the caller
environment, retains its receiving view, then dispatches on the actual returned
executable. Argument execution has not started at this point.

The closure branch at 1224–1329 uses the closure's saved environment; the local
pattern binding shadows the caller-environment variable. It applies the received
dispatch substitution to that environment, establishes an invocation owner and
ReceiverReturn frame, then selects the closure's actual role. ReceiverReturn
contains activation/previous owner fields, not an environment field.

Value role pushes ValueEntry and executes the delayed argument. Computation role
creates any declared root/receipt view, binds the Delay itself as a Computation
parameter in the saved environment, and evaluates the body without forcing the
argument. This supports the formal A versus Thunk A distinction. It does not
prove that root/callback receipts or dispatch metadata realize formal paths.

A new `dynamicCall` has a value callee and a thunk-valued argument. Source Apply
also evaluates a callee computation; its eventual translation needs a preceding
bind and capture-avoiding shifts of the argument code. No all-source Apply
elaboration theorem is claimed by the Function embedding.

Native call dispatch also accepts Primitive, Continuation and operation
providers, with their own entry behavior and suffix ownership. Finite lambda/
wrap syntax is not universal coverage of these providers. Full Call adequacy
still needs those branches and its original independent quantifiers.

### Actual Value entry and patterns

`Frame::ValueEntry` at 1438–1488 first validates and introduces any callback
schema. The schema check can fail on pattern form, owner, parameter identity,
source root or received interface. It then handles record fields, unit validation
or an ordinary full parameter bind. A unit pattern validates Unit and does not
introduce an ordinary parameter cell. Record patterns bind actual fields/default
results one by one; `RecordDefault` at 1489–1498 and `bind_record_parameter` at
2655–2689 preserve the environment extended by earlier fields. Defaults evaluate
in that environment and can suspend/fail/diverge. Computation entry does not
branch on these pattern flags before binding its Delay.

The one-binder formal lambda rule covers its existing abstract body contract.
Source pattern elaboration must separately construct that body and prove the
field/default staging laws; simply ignoring pattern flags is not correspondence.

### Names and current cells

`program.rs:780–805` resolves imported names using retained imported bindings and
supplies parameter NameConsumption from the role table; other names Observe.
Inconsistent supplied consumption evidence is rejected. `machine.rs:781–862`
resolves the full parameter/local/catch identity (or global definition index),
reads the current cell, performs dispatch-name transport, then consumes it.
Uninitialized globals trigger initialization; uninitialized lexical cells fail.
`consume` at 2469–2501 validates receiving metadata, records a receipt, and either
returns the value or executes a Computation-interface value with substitution.
`execute_with_substitution` at 2551–2583 accepts Delay/Request executables and can
fail with ExpectedComputation for other representations.

Therefore a formal variable lookup alone does not prove source Name execution:
layout/address/current-value typing, observation versus execution, dispatch,
receipts and initialization remain separate source obligations. Old represented
capture typing can be transported to the new core because its actual successful
reads are already available; it cannot magically encode native closure graphs.

## 4. Parent consumption and exact remaining inputs

The selected formal endpoint turns each existing `FunctionTyped f a b` into a
value typing derivation of callable(embed a,embed b). Such a value can inhabit a
response binder, serve as a higher-order argument and be stored in the generic
native Store. The old successful capture supplier's per-index typing derivations
can be embedded without replacing its read-success premises by an opaque claim.
This removes the *missing callable value syntax* part of ENV-CALLABLE-1 only.

| Remaining gate | Exact evidence still needed / source owner |
| --- | --- |
| HO-SUBSTITUTION-1 | Capture-avoiding substitution/weakening for the new full syntax, including lambda/adapter binders and callable-valued request continuations. Owner: higher-order proof lane. |
| ENV-LAYOUT-1 | Construct finite free-variable layouts from real body labels/resolved identities, including nested source binders and pattern/default scopes. Owner: program construction plus body elaboration. |
| ENV-CELL-VALUE-1 | Encode actual current ReceivedValue/executable cells at all needed higher-order types, preserving views/interface/dispatch. Owner: machine cell producers and receiving/dispatch representation. |
| ENV-GRAPH-1 | Finite shared and recursive closure/delay graph readback and typing, including preallocated uninitialized cells. Owner: machine local/global initialization and graph proof. |
| ENV-CALLABLE-1 | Close source body using the actual layout/current cells; connect native role, patterns, result consumer and metadata to the new lambda/wrap value. Owner: program Lambda/Apply and machine Callee/ValueEntry. |
| ENV-DISPATCH-1 / RESPONSE-TEMPLATE-1 | Typed metadata/frame interpretation and error exclusion; previously proved address/replay structure is insufficient. Owner: dispatch/receiving/template constructors and consumers. |
| Whole source/Call/Force/inference A/B | All constructors, substitutions, traces, constraints, propagation, levels/generalization and original premises remain at their original owners. |

No runtime defect was demonstrated at Lambda/Callee or Value/Computation entry:
NO_SAFE_CODE_SLICE. No change to source restrictions, runtime behavior, expected
outputs, or compiler acceptance is inferred from the new research typing rules.

## Syntax and quantifiers

`HigherOrderSyntax.lean` retains every old type constructor, all eight literal
domains and their exact payload representations, variables, delay, injections,
single-child intersection/top values and all seven Original computations. It
adds the existing Call view/scope/expose/request/fail nodes, lambda/wrap values,
and dynamicCall. Request's continuation binds its operation instance's response
type. The type language can place callable types beneath thunk/union/intersection
and in operation instances. The value, computation and adapter syntax is mutually
inductive; all typing judgments are defined afterwards.

Value-entry lambda binds A; computation-entry lambda binds Thunk A. Both retain
receipt, annotated input/body/result types, body and result consumer. Wrap keeps
the input adapter c→a and output adapter b→d around an a→b function. DynamicCall
accepts a thunk carrier. This fixes a research typing interface without asserting
an execution rule or operational equivalence for the new constructor.

`ContextEmbedding old new` quantifies over every old lookup fact. The mutual
Original and TypedCall preservation proofs quantify over arbitrary old terms,
old typing derivations and target contexts satisfying that relation. Closed
Original nodes embed under any target context using the empty lookup relation;
binders use `extend_embedding`. The Function theorem quantifies over every old
FunctionTyped derivation and every target context. No original constructor,
source-domain restriction or independent continuation quantifier is discarded.
This is one-way typing preservation, not reflection or full conservativity.

## Metadata boundary

Paths retain component lists, port kinds and translated endpoint types;
occurrences retain identities and paths. Operation instances retain operation
identity, ordered type arguments and both payload/response types. Receipt slots
and profiles retain order, identity and typed paths. Adapter metadata retains
all path correspondences and captured occurrences. Interface-port metadata also
has a structural map.

PathRule is a Prop in the accepted input. `embedPathRule` translates its proof
into a new Prop proof. It does not eliminate that proof into a data-valued map
identity. In particular the old permissive adapterMap rule remains permissive;
this work cannot prove that a mappingIdentity absent from runtime data can be
reconstructed. Syntax is **typing-proof-free**, not entirely proof-free. The old
Adapter.typed field is omitted from syntax and consumed solely to construct the
new extrinsic AdapterTyped derivation. The retained PathRule metadata neither
contains a typing judgment nor creates a typing-definition cycle.

## Parent application

`embedFunction_typed` constructs a ValueTyped callable from an old FunctionTyped
proof. `function_as_argument` and `call_with_function_argument` use it in the
actual new delayed argument and dynamicCall constructors.
`request_callable_response` constructs a request that binds and returns a
callable-typed response. `function_cell` pushes the embedded function into the
existing generic NativeClosureEnvironment.Store, proves the actual current cell
equality and supplies its callable typing derivation.

`read_embedding` preserves the exact old selected cell address while mapping the
current store pointwise. `read_embedding_typed` combines that equation with the
accepted `successful_read_typed` theorem. `captured_value_typed` applies the
accepted `realized_substitution_typed` supplier to each represented context index;
`captured_body_typed` applies its actual successful capture and closed-body
construction before embedding. Both keep successful realization and CellsTyped
as explicit original premises. Nothing claims that arbitrary native closures
already satisfy those premises, or that old stores already represent new
callable values. Generic new callable storage and old represented-read transport
are two separate constructions whose native connection is still open.

existing domains. CoreSubstitution's bind/request lifting is reused through
close_body, without reproving lookup or assuming a new substitution rule. The
NativeClosureEnvironment.Store remains generic; no machine fields change.
Historical literal readback is not extended to callable readback by analogy.
No failure is dismissed by a narrower theorem; no new source restriction,

OPEN. No F1/FK1 or foreign-continuation theorem is claimed here.
